title: Management ACL: specific rule first
summary: Build and bind an inbound SSH management ACL without losing the default deny.
brief: On Ethernet1, allow SSH only from 192.0.2.0/24 and deny all other IPv4 traffic. Use the ACL name MGMT-SAFE. Put the specific permit before the deny, then apply it inbound. This lab grades configured ACL order and interface binding only; it does not simulate traffic, counters, or remote-management reachability.
objectives: Permit SSH from 192.0.2.0/24 before the deny
Apply the ACL inbound on Ethernet1
Verify both the ACL and its interface binding
hints: Create a named ACL from global configuration.
Use sequence 10 for the SSH permit and 20 for the deny.
Bind it under Ethernet1 with an inbound ip access-group command.

checks.name: MGMT-SAFE
checks.label: MGMT-SAFE permits the management subnet before denying remaining IPv4 traffic
